claims.text: The Arrabelle is a ski-in/ski-out resort in Lionshead Village, steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola with direct access to Vail Mountain.

findings.quote: is a premier ski-in/ski-out luxury resort in Lionshead Village, steps from the Eagle Bahn Gondola and direct access to Vail Mountain.

claims.text: The hotel is managed by Vail Resorts under the RockResorts banner.

findings.quote: managed by Vail Resorts under the RockResorts banner

claims.text: The facade layers creamy stucco with rough-cut stone, arched windows and timber Juliet balconies, with roughly two dozen hand-painted alpine murals.

findings.quote: The façade layers creamy stucco with rough-cut stone, arched windows, and timber Juliet balconies, and roughly two dozen delicate, hand-painted alpine murals

claims.text: The lobby has high ceilings with exposed wood beams and iron chandeliers.

findings.quote: The lobby functions as the hotel’s default meeting spot. The room is spacious, with high ceilings punctuated by exposed wood beams and iron chandeliers

claims.text: Hotel rooms have carved-wood headboards, gas fireplaces with hand-painted murals and balconies facing either the Gore Range or Lionshead Square.

findings.quote: The hotel rooms follow a consistent design ethos, with carved-wood headboards, gas fireplaces with hand-painted murals, thick drapery, and balconies that face either the Gore Range or Lionshead Square.

claims.text: Private residences range from one to five bedrooms.

findings.quote: a collection of private residences that range from one to five bedrooms

claims.text: The residences have full kitchens, dining areas, living rooms with fireplaces and laundry.

findings.quote: These spaces also feature full kitchens, dining areas, living rooms with fireplaces, and laundry

claims.text: The hotel has a RockResorts Spa, and its locker rooms include a steam room and a sauna.

findings.quote: The award-winning RockResorts Spa
Locker rooms include a steam room and a sauna

claims.text: The hotel has rooftop hot tubs and a lap pool.

findings.quote: Rooftop hot tubs and lap pool

claims.text: Tavern on the Square is the hotel's main restaurant, opening directly onto Lionshead's main plaza.

findings.quote: Tavern on the Square is the hotel’s anchor restaurant, opening directly onto Lionshead’s main plaza

claims.text: There is a summer amphitheater with featured concerts.

findings.quote: Summer amphitheater with featured concerts

claims.text: Guests have access to the Red Sky Golf Club.

findings.quote: Exclusive access to the Red Sky Golf Club

claims.text: The rooftop pool deck is heated year-round, with a hot tub facing the mountains.

findings.quote: the rooftop pool deck—heated year-round—with a hot tub facing the mountains

claims.text: The hotel offers a slopeside ski and boot valet and equipment storage service, plus a ski concierge.

findings.quote: Slopeside ski and boot valet and equipment storage service
Ski Concierge

claims.text: The Arrabelle has a plaza with an open-air ice rink in winter, plus year-round shopping, dining and apres-ski just outside the door.

findings.quote: The Arrabelle features a vibrant plaza with an open-air ice rink in winter, plus year-round shopping, dining, and après-ski, all just outside your door.

claims.text: A sky bridge connects the hotel's buildings, with views of the ice skating rink and the mountain.

findings.quote: check out the sky bridge connecting The Arrabelle’s buildings—not only is the view of the ice skating rink and the mountain incredible

claims.text: Each residence has its own decor, with artwork, textiles and furniture that vary.

findings.quote: each one has its own décor. Artwork, textiles, and even furniture selections vary

claims.text: Plaza-facing rooms can catch noise during peak season; mountain-view rooms are recommended.

findings.quote: Book a mountain-view room if you can; plaza-facing rooms are great for people-watching but can catch noise during peak season.

claims.text: The concierge can arrange dinner reservations and private ski instructors; peak-season requests need advance notice.

findings.quote: The concierge can wrangle dinner reservations and arrange private ski instructors, though peak-season requests require advance notice.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing and peak winter demand.
